security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data: https:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first trading journal and second brain
bundle.longDescription: Whale is a local-first, open-source trading journal and second brain: linked Markdown notes, a 3D whale-shaped brain view, an Obsidian-style editor and AI (Claude or Ollama) that answers from your own journal.
